findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:267 reconciles work identity before checking Project membership. That reconciliation appends `Work identity: BR-N` to the stored body (managed_work_identity.py:51), while duplicate detection compares it directly against the original rendered body (requirement_intake.py:290). A read-only, in-memory reproduction of two identical create calls with an unavailable Project created Issues #42 and #43. The advertised recovery command therefore duplicates Requirements.
findings.summary: An identical create retry creates another Issue instead of continuing the durable Requirement.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:281 and :324 pass `gh api --paginate` output to managed_task.run_json without `--slurp`. The [GitHub CLI documentation](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_api) specifies that each page is a separate JSON value, but managed_task.py:233 parses the entire output with one json.loads call. In-memory reproduction with two page arrays made both duplicate lookup and reconcile-board --all raise `ManagedTaskError: gh api did not return structured JSON`. With more than 100 matching open Issues, create cannot proceed and bulk repair cannot run.
findings.summary: Create and bulk reconciliation fail when open Requirements span multiple API pages.
